# Digital twin run — AI & automation wave 1

*Model: `TWIN-BASE-10B` v1.1 (2026-07) — Archetype IDN — $10B NPR, single-instance Epic on AWS, Snowflake EDW, Databricks lakehouse. Horizon 36 months. Generated by `twin.py`; do not hand-edit.*

> Eight-intervention automation portfolio across the cycle: auth submission and tracking, eligibility orchestration and coverage discovery, autonomous coding expansion, edit resolution, intelligent posting, denial/appeal AI, AR status bots, and a patient billing agent. Staffing capture is attrition-based and trails each capability by ~2 quarters.

## Payer response dynamics

Payer behavior is endogenous in this run: sustained provider gains trigger lagged, capped counter-moves. Intensities are 0–1 (1.0 = full response).

| Rule | Counter-move | Trigger metric | First active | Peak | End |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PR-01 | Algorithmic denial re-tightening on discretionary categories | prevention_gain_pts ≥ 0.015 | M13 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| PR-02 | Appeal slow-walk & documentation friction | appeal_recovery_gain_pts ≥ 0.04 | M11 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| PR-03 | Auth surface expansion | auth_automation_gain_pts ≥ 0.2 | M11 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| PR-04 | Payment friction & records-request escalation | writeoff_reduction_pts ≥ 0.005 | M13 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| PR-05 | Downcode & silent underpayment pressure | writeoff_reduction_pts ≥ 0.006 | — | 0.00 | 0.00 |

| Measure | Gross (no payer response) | Net (with payer response) | Erosion |
|---|---|---|---|
| Steady-state net revenue /yr | +$65.6M | +$42.5M | −$23.1M |
| 3-year NPV | +$233.9M | +$110.5M | 53% |
| Net days in AR (end) | 46.3 | 49.8 | +3.5 d |
| Initial denial rate (end) | 9.8% | 10.5% | +0.7 pt |

*All headline figures elsewhere in this report are NET of payer response. Responses are bounded (MLR floors, Stars/CTM exposure, prompt-pay statutes, employer abrasion) and decay if the provider posture normalizes — see `payer_dynamics` rationale fields in the config.*
